blurb: Guests fish for salmon, lake trout, steelhead, cisco, whitefish, and small mouth bass on a 27' Triton boat in West Bay, Traverse City. Trips are guided by experienced staff using quality equipment. After fishing, catch is cleaned at a private station and can be cooked at a local restaurant.
extraNote: Reservations accepted for Spring, Summer, Fall seasons · Marina at 12935 S W Bay Shore Dr, Traverse City, MI · Spring | Summer | Fall fishing season
